hypothesis: Doubling only goal_progress from 20 to 40 will improve success rate and reduce final goal distance at a fixed training budget. A possible tradeoff is overshooting near the goal.
checkpoint_selection: best.pt selected only on seed 131000 validation; initial candidate allowed; never select using final evaluation
report_uncertainty: mean and sample standard deviation across the three training seeds; report all paired differences

pilot.purpose: Measure throughput and learning at the previous lesson budget; excluded from final comparison; no final held-out evaluation

budget_decision: Use four times the previous lesson budget, fixed before any final comparison evaluation. Physics, reset distribution, network, PPO defaults and action/observation definitions are unchanged.
hardware_note: Both GPUs are RTX A6000. GPU 1 also runs an unrelated workload. Wall times describe this shared workstation and are not controlled speed comparisons or Colab T4 benchmarks.
